rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-requirements/SKILL.md` has the front matter that marks a bundled skill, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions.references`. The requirement only binds a skill that links to side files for specialized material. Each such link must say when to read the file.

The skill points to two side files, and both say when to read them:
- `references/review-prompt.md` appears in workflow step 3 (Review). A read-only subagent is told to read it, and step 3 says to start those subagents for each group of new or changed requirements. The trigger is clear.
- `references/fixme.md` belongs to the habeas-evidence skill. It appears in "Choosing references" with the condition "To defer a requirement gap the user agrees to, use `{fixme}` as … describes." That also says when to read it.

The skill has no unconditional or vague "see also" links to side files. I found no violation of the requirement and no gap.

text: A bundled skill MAY put material needed only in specialized situations in files it links to. Each such link MUST say when to read the file. Each bundled skill, recognized by its front matter, is a site:
